# mux_webhook (Resource)

A webhook: an address Mux sends the environment's event notifications to. Changing the address keeps the webhook and its signing secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mux_webhook" "events" {
  address = "https://example.com/webhooks/mux"
}

output "mux_webhook_signing_secret" {
  value     = mux_webhook.events.signing_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) URL Mux sends notifications to. It must be unique among the environment's webhooks.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Mux delivers notifications to the webhook. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the webhook was created, as an ISO 8601 UTC datetime.
- `id` (String) Webhook ID.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret for verifying that a notification was sent by Mux. Mux returns it only when the webhook is created, so an imported webhook has none. It is stored in the state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by webhook ID. Mux does not return the signing secret of an existing webhook.
terraform import mux_webhook.events abc12d
```
